o.norm: org.evosuite.runtime.mock.java.lang.MockThrowable: Either opt or longOpt must be specified

i.norm: Verifies that getParsedOptionValue wraps into a ParseException the exception thrown by the default-value Supplier when the option has no value on the command line. The option being looked up (longOpt="Options") is not present on the empty CommandLine, so the fallback Supplier is invoked. That Supplier is an Option.Builder configured with a null opt and no longOpt; calling its get() method throws "Either opt or longOpt must be specified", which getParsedOptionValue must re-throw as a ParseException.
Build an empty CommandLine (no options parsed)
Option to look up: short opt is null, longOpt is "Options" — not present on the command line
Default-value Supplier that is itself broken: no opt or longOpt configured, so calling its get() throws "Either opt or longOpt must be specified"
Because targetOption is absent, the fallback Supplier is called. The Supplier throws, so getParsedOptionValue must propagate a ParseException.
